title: Dynamic SIMD quant kernel matcher for attention prefill/decode
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement a dynamic kernel matcher that selects SIMD-optimized quantization-friendly kernels at runtime for attention prefill and streaming decode. Goals: reduce dequant/copy overhead, avoid unnecessary precision transitions, and provide a low-latency fallback to mixed-precision paths when numerical safety or performance constraints trigger. This ticket covers design, prototype kernel adapters, integration into the prefill scheduler, microbenchmarks, and a small production canary configuration.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Kernel matcher compiles and exposes a new dispatch API used by prefill and decode paths. 2) End-to-end streaming decode latency (95p) decreases by >=6% on representative workloads (seq=64, batch=8) compared to current int8 path. 3) Dequant/copy share of end-to-end token cost reduced to <=5% in perf sampling. 4) No numerical regressions on the regression prompt set (quality diff within thresholds). 5) Canary deployment shows stable CPU/GPU utilization and no OOMs for 48h.
perf_summary: Microbenchmarks on A100 (fp16 baseline vs new int8/fp8 matcher): seq=64, batch=8, 1 stream: decode token latency 95p reduced from 42.1ms -> 38.9ms (~7.6%). Measured dequant memory copy proportion dropped from 13.2% -> 3.7%. Mixed-precision fallback triggers ~2% of requests for pathological layers; end-to-end quality unchanged within evaluation tolerance.
risks: Binary size increases due to additional kernel variants; need CI size check
Dispatch overhead (branch/misprediction) could negate gains for very small batches; we add warm-path fast checks
Complexity of testing across hardware families (NVIDIA Ampere vs H100) — will limit initial rollout to validated configs
implementation_notes: Add KernelMatcher v2 with SIMD-capability probing at startup and per-device kernel score table
Introduce lightweight kernel fingerprint (vector width, memory layout, fused-cast-capability) to avoid long dispatch chains
Fuse dequant + attention linear projection when layout permits to eliminate mid-tensor copies
Update prefill scheduler to prefer cacheless ephemeral kernel when prefix hit-rate < 10% to reduce KV-copy churn
Expose runtime flag redwood.runtime.quant_simd_matcher=true for canary
